description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target physical attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, Damage +5/10/15/20/25/30% to party if target has 0/1/2/3/4/5 Stat Breaks, Lv.2 En-Earth Stack or Lv.2 En-Holy Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Earth/Holy Damage +20%, Physical Casting Speed x1.1 & chases an Earth/Holy ability with single-target Earth/Holy physical attack (3.36 each) capped at 99999  + ATK/MAG/DEF/RES -50% (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Earth/Holy, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Shatter Armor+: 1.65s CT, Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user

description.name: Shatter Armor+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, cast time 3.30/2.90/2.475/2.075/1.65 scaling with [Shatter Armor Uses], causes [Imperil Earth 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Holy 10% (5s)]
